tracking: ADR-0356 (lane E37): the brief is API and backend only; the Atlassian audit feed screen is requested on #453 (lane brief rule 3, recorded in ADR-0356)

gaps.POST /v1/pm/audit-sources: adds a read-only Atlassian organisation audit feed (Rovo-agent and MCP events) to a Jira connection, disabled
gaps.GET /v1/pm/audit-sources: lists the Atlassian audit feeds (never the key)
gaps.PATCH /v1/pm/audit-sources/:sourceId: enables or disables an Atlassian audit feed, changes its filters or replaces its key (enable and key are settings_relax step-ups)
gaps.POST /v1/pm/audit-sources/:sourceId/poll: polls an enabled Atlassian audit feed now and stores matching events as evidence
gaps.GET /v1/pm/audit-sources/:sourceId/event: pages the stored Rovo/MCP audit events of a feed
